title: Enable File Log
description: Enables or disables logging to a file on disk

title: Backend Threading
description: Whether or not backend threading is enabled. The "Auto" setting will determine whether threading should be enabled at runtime.

title: Res Scale
description: Resolution Scale. An integer scale applied to applicable render targets. Values 1-4, or -1 to use a custom floating point scale instead.

title: Res Scale Custom
description: Custom Resolution Scale. A custom floating point scale applied to applicable render targets. Only active when Resolution Scale is -1.

title: Max Anisotropy
description: Max Anisotropy. Values range from 0 - 16. Set to -1 to let the game decide.

title: Aspect Ratio
description: Aspect Ratio applied to the renderer window.

title: Anti Aliasing
description: Applies anti-aliasing to the renderer.

title: Scaling Filter
description: Sets the framebuffer upscaling type.

title: Scaling Filter Level
description: Sets the framebuffer upscaling level.

title: Graphics Shaders Dump Path
description: Dumps shaders in this local directory

title: Logging Enable Debug
description: Enables printing debug log messages

title: Logging Enable Stub
description: Enables printing stub log messages

title: Logging Enable Info
description: Enables printing info log messages

title: Logging Enable Warn
description: Enables printing warning log messages

title: Logging Enable Error
description: Enables printing error log messages

title: Logging Enable Trace
description: Enables printing trace log messages

title: Logging Enable Guest
description: Enables printing guest log messages

title: Logging Enable Fs Access Log
description: Enables printing FS access log messages

title: Logging Enable Net Log
description: Enables printing network log messages

title: Logging Graphics Debug Level
description: Change Graphics API debug log level

title: System Language
description: Change System Language

title: System Region
description: Change System Region

title: System Time Zone
description: Change System TimeZone

title: System Time Offset
description: Change System Time Offset in seconds

title: Match System Time
description: Instead of setting the time via configuration, use the values provided by the system.

title: Docked Mode
description: Enables or disables Docked Mode

title: VSync Mode
description: Current VSync mode; 60 (Switch), unbounded ("Vsync off"), or custom

title: Enable Custom VSync Interval
description: Enables or disables the custom present interval

title: Custom VSync Interval
description: The custom present interval value

title: Enable Shader Cache
description: Enables or disables Shader cache

title: Enable Texture Recompression
description: Enables or disables texture recompression

title: Enable Macro HLE
description: Enables or disables Macro high-level emulation

title: Enable Color Space Passthrough
description: Enables or disables color space passthrough, if available.

title: Enable Ptc
description: Enables or disables profiled translation cache persistency

title: Enable Low Power Ptc
description: Enables or disables low-power profiled translation cache persistency loading

title: Tick Scalar
description: Clock tick scalar, in percent points (100 = 1.0).

title: Enable Internet Access
description: Enables or disables guest Internet access

title: Enable Fs Integrity Checks
description: Enables integrity checks on Game content files

title: Fs Global Access Log Mode
description: Enables FS access log output to the console. Possible modes are 0-3

title: Audio Volume
description: The audio volume

title: Dram Size
description: Expands the RAM amount on the emulated system

title: Ignore Missing Services
description: Enable or disable ignoring missing services

title: Enable Keyboard
description: Enable or disable keyboard support (Independent from controllers binding)

title: Enable Mouse
description: Enable or disable mouse support (Independent from controllers binding)

title: Multiplayer Mode
description: Multiplayer Mode

title: Multiplayer Lan Interface Id
description: GUID for the network interface used by LAN (or 0 for default)

title: Multiplayer Disable P2p
description: Disable P2p Toggle

title: Multiplayer Ldn Passphrase
description: Local network passphrase, for private networks.

title: Ldn Server
description: Custom LDN Server

title: GCLow Latency
description: Enable or disable low-latency mode for garbage collection

title: Enable Gdb Stub
description: Enables or disables the GDB stub

title: Gdb Stub Port
description: Which TCP port should the GDB stub listen on

title: Debugger Suspend On Start
description: Suspend execution when starting an application
